item.title: Alabama Senate votes to further reduce powers of lieutenant governor
item.description: The Alabama Senate on Thursday unanimously changed the chamber’s rules, reducing the powers of the lieutenant governor. Senate Resolution 108, sponsored by Sen. item.description: WASHINGTON — U.S. Senate Democrats this week blasted the Trump administration’s attempts to shift management of federal student loans from the Education Department to the Treasury Department, saying it would contribute to dysfunction in the student loan system. item.title: Gov. Kay Ivey signs bill giving governor more control over PSC
item.description: Gov. item.description: The Alabama House of Representatives Thursday passed a bill that would create a body to revise the K-12 accountability system in public schools. HB 604, sponsored by Rep. item.title: Alabama House sends bill increasing penalties for eluding police to Gov. Kay Ivey
item.description: The Alabama House of Representatives Thursday passed a bill that increases penalties for eluding a police officer. SB 233, sponsored by Sen. item.title: Alabama Senate passes $10.5 billion education budget with pay raises, retiree bonuses
item.description: The Alabama Senate on Thursday passed a $10.5 billion education budget with minor changes, sending it back to the House for final approval. item.title: Reports: US fighter jet downed over Iran, one crew member rescued
item.description: WASHINGTON — A U.S. fighter jet went down over Iran Friday and one crew member has been rescued, according to several media reports. Iranian state media reported the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps was responsible. The attack marks the first time Iran has shot down U.S. military aircraft since the war’s start. item.description: WASHINGTON — The Trump administration released its fiscal 2027 budget request Friday, asking Congress to increase spending on defense programs by 43% and decrease funding for non-defense accounts by 10%.
